hints.title: Small Value Range
hints.text: Notice that values in nums range between -50 and 50, which is extremely compact.

hints.title: Frequency Array Sliding Window
hints.text: Maintain a frequency count of elements inside the window of size k using an offset array of size 101.

hints.title: Finding x-th Smallest Negative
hints.text: Iterate through negative buckets (-50 to -1). If the cumulative count reaches x, that value is the beauty; otherwise the beauty is 0.

hints.title: Bucket-Based Sliding Window Implementation

complexity.notes: Fixed window maintenance with small-range bucket scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting each subarray of size k takes O(n * k log k) which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) space for 101-element bucket frequency array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverages the [-50, 50] value constraint for O(50) order-statistic lookup.
